accounts.name: executor
docs: The bound trading key or the operator. Pays the rent of the custody
account and of the vault's wSOL account, and gets it back at settlement.

accounts.name: custody
docs: trade under vault custody, which cannot default: the principal is in
the vault, so the trader unwinds and settles instead.

accounts.name: config
docs: Last, so clients built for the previous program version (which had no
config) keep working against it: a trailing extra account is ignored.

instructions.name: draw_funds
docs: Disabled since vault custody; see `begin_trading`.

accounts.name: executor
docs: The bound trading key or the operator. At or after the deadline, also
the trader, who may then only swap back into wSOL.

accounts.name: position_vault
docs: The token authority of every vault token account. Signs the DEX call.

accounts.name: config
docs: Last, so clients built for the previous program version (which had no
config) keep working against it: a trailing extra account is ignored.

accounts.name: executor
docs: The bound trading key or the operator (or, for a custody position at
or after the deadline, the trader). On the legacy path, sends the
returned SOL.

accounts.name: custody
docs: position that trades under vault custody and is empty otherwise.

accounts.name: vault_wsol
docs: The vault's wSOL account. Required for a custody position.

accounts.name: config
docs: The protocol config, for the late penalty. Required for a custody position.

errors.name: InvalidCollateralRatio

errors.name: InvalidDrawdown
errors.msg: Max drawdown exceeds the protocol limit

errors.name: InvalidName
errors.msg: Name is empty or too long

errors.name: InvalidDescription
errors.msg: Description is too long

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InsufficientFreeCollateral
errors.msg: Agent does not have enough free collateral to guarantee this position

errors.name: UnauthorizedOperator
errors.msg: Only the agent operator may perform this action

errors.name: UnauthorizedTrader
errors.msg: Only the position trader may perform this action

errors.name: InvalidStatus
errors.msg: Position is not in the expected status

errors.name: InvalidDuration
errors.msg: Position duration is outside the agent's published trading window

errors.name: DeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Position deadline has not been reached yet

errors.name: DeadlinePassed
errors.msg: Position deadline has passed; the trader may claim default

errors.name: AgentNotAccepting
errors.msg: Agent is not accepting new positions

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: FeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Fee exceeds the cap allowed by the collateral ratio

errors.name: InvalidTradingWindow
errors.msg: Trading window is invalid

errors.name: InvalidAllowedAssets

errors.name: InvalidRules
errors.msg: Rules must be published and fit the size limit

errors.name: TermsLocked

errors.name: NotPublished
errors.msg: Agent has not been published

errors.name: AlreadyPublished
errors.msg: Agent is already published

errors.name: NoCollateral
errors.msg: Deposit collateral before publishing the agent

errors.name: UnauthorizedExecutor

errors.name: RatioPlusDrawdownTooHigh

errors.name: ProtocolPaused

errors.name: PositionTooLarge

errors.name: AgentCapReached

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdmin

errors.name: InvalidCaps

errors.name: DrawDisabled

errors.name: UseSettle

errors.name: DexNotAllowed

errors.name: MintNotAllowed

errors.name: VaultNotUnwound

errors.name: SwapTooMuchIn

errors.name: SwapBelowOracle

errors.name: OracleFeedMismatch

errors.name: OraclePriceStale

errors.name: OracleNotVerified

errors.name: OraclePriceInvalid

errors.name: VaultAccountTampered

errors.name: SameMint

errors.name: TokenAccountNotEmpty

errors.name: InvalidTradingConfig

errors.name: NoFeedForMint

errors.name: CustodyAccountsMissing

types.name: AcceptingChanged
docs: The operator paused or resumed new positions on a published agent.

types.name: Agent
docs: An AI trading agent created and managed by an operator.

fields.name: operator
docs: Creator and manager: controls terms, collateral, and the trading key.

fields.name: executor
docs: Key allowed to draw and settle positions. Defaults to the operator.

fields.name: agent_id
docs: Per-operator index, part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: total_collateral
docs: Lamports the operator has deposited as collateral (excluding the vault rent floor).

fields.name: locked_collateral
docs: Collateral reserved for open positions.

fields.name: capital_managed
docs: Principal currently under management.

fields.name: settled_positions
docs: Positions the agent drew and later settled (on time or late). Positions
declined before a draw are not counted.

fields.name: breach_count
docs: Positions that ended in a breach: a drawdown beyond tolerance, a late
settle, or a claimed default.

types.name: AgentTerms
docs: The rules and collateral terms an operator publishes for an agent.
Editable while the agent is a draft, permanent once it is published.

fields.name: collateral_ratio_bps
docs: Collateral guaranteed per deposited lamport, in bps (3000 = 30%).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Performance fee on profit, in bps. At most collateral_ratio_bps / FEE_CAP_DIVISOR.

fields.name: max_drawdown_bps
docs: Loss the agent may incur before its bond pays the trader, in bps of principal.

fields.name: min_duration_secs
docs: Shortest and longest position a trader may open, in seconds.

fields.name: allowed_assets
docs: Token mints the agent commits to trading.

fields.name: rules
docs: The agent's full trading rules in plain language.

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol-wide limits, set by the program's upgrade authority. They can stop
new money from entering and cap how much a position or an agent may hold.
They cannot move funds, and nothing here stops a trader from cancelling,
an agent from settling, a trader from claiming a default, or an operator
from withdrawing free collateral.

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops new positions, draws and collateral deposits.

fields.name: max_position
docs: Largest principal one position may hold, in lamports.

fields.name: max_agent_capital
docs: Largest principal one agent may manage across its open positions, in lamports.

fields.name: allowed_dex_programs
docs: Programs `execute_swap` may call. Empty means no position can trade.

fields.name: oracle_program
docs: Owner every price update account must have (the Pyth receiver program).

fields.name: max_price_age_secs
docs: Oldest publish time a swap may be priced with, in seconds.

fields.name: max_swap_deviation_bps
docs: Largest loss of oracle value one swap may take, in bps.

fields.name: late_penalty_bps
docs: Share of the locked bond paid to the trader when a custody position
settles at or after its deadline, in bps.

fields.name: feeds
docs: Which oracle feed prices which mint. A mint without a feed cannot be traded.

types.name: ConfigChanged
docs: The upgrade authority created or changed the protocol config.

types.name: Custody
docs: Created when a position begins trading under vault custody and closed when
it settles. Its existence is what tells the program a position's principal
is in the vault rather than in the trading wallet.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the rent of this account and of the vault's wrapped SOL account;
gets both back at settlement.

fields.name: held_mask
docs: Bit `i` is set while the vault's token account for
`agent.terms.allowed_assets[i]` holds a non-zero balance. Wrapped SOL
is the base asset and never in the mask.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth feed id (32 bytes).

types.name: FundsDrawn
docs: The agent's trading key drew a position's principal to trade with it.

types.name: Position
docs: A trader's capital allocation to an agent, backed by reserved collateral.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Per-trader nonce used in the PDA seed.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Snapshot of the agent's terms at open time.

fields.name: trader_payout
docs: Lamports paid to the trader for this position: returned principal
minus fee plus any slash (settle), the principal (cancel or decline),
or the slashed bond (default). Excludes the position vault's rent
floor, which is also refunded to the trader when the vault is drained.

types.name: PositionDeclined
docs: The agent declined a position it never drew: the trader got the principal
back and the agent's reputation counters were not changed. Emitted
alongside `PositionClosed` (status `Settled`, breach `None`) so indexers can
tell a decline apart from a settle that returned exactly the principal.

types.name: SwapExecuted
docs: A custody position swapped between two of its vault token accounts.
`value_in` and `value_out` are the oracle values of the two legs, in the
output mint's units scaled to the same exponent, so their ratio is the
price the swap got relative to the oracle.

types.name: TradingConfigChanged
docs: The upgrade authority changed what custody positions may trade.

constants.name: FEE_CAP_DIVISOR
docs: The fee an operator may charge is capped by its collateral:
fee_bps <= collateral_ratio_bps / FEE_CAP_DIVISOR.
30% collateral -> at most 15% of profit, 100% collateral -> at most 50%.

constants.name: MAX_COLLATERAL_RATIO_BPS
docs: Maximum collateral ratio (100%: every deposited lamport is fully backed).

constants.name: MAX_DRAWDOWN_BPS
docs: Maximum drawdown an operator may declare as tolerated trading loss (50%).

constants.name: MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO_BPS
docs: Minimum collateral an agent must guarantee per unit of capital (10%).

constants.name: MIN_POSITION_DURATION
docs: Bounds for the trading window an operator may offer.
